description: The Claude Code version the fleet runs. `fabric-ctl <login|all> upgrade claude` brings each account to it — stopping a running session gracefully, installing, and the launcher resuming the session on it (docs/fleet-upgrade.md). Moving the fleet is a one-line change here, reviewed like any other; a --version on the command overrides it for one account, for a trial. Background auto-update is off on every account (autoUpdates: false), so nothing else moves it.
